title: DISTINCTCOUNT over '', BLANK and x is 3: the empty string and BLANK are different values

source.quote: DISTINCTCOUNT function counts the BLANK value
source.supports: BLANK is one of the counted values

source.quote: Returns TRUE if Product[Color] is an empty string, returns FALSE if it is BLANK or any other value
source.supports: Column == "" is TRUE only for the empty string

derivation: Empty[Txt] holds '' (Id 1), BLANK (Id 2), x (Id 3). DISTINCTCOUNT counts BLANK as a value. == and ISBLANK tell the empty string from BLANK, so they are separate values: '', BLANK and x make 3.
alternative: No source says outright that a column keeps the empty string and BLANK as two dictionary values. If grouping compares them as = does (BLANK equal to the empty string), the result is 2.
